dogecoin.text: @elonmusk Elon, looking at this chart… should Tesla start accepting U.S. Treasury bonds as payment? Because at this rate, they might be worth less than Dogecoin soon.
@elonmusk Elon, at this point, should we just YOLO the U.S. economy into Dogecoin? 🐶💸 At least then we can say it’s backed by something—even if that something is just memes.

@elonmusk Ah yes, the classic ‘infinite money glitch’—except it’s not a video game, it’s the U.S. budget. At this point, we might as well put the entire economy on Dogecoin and let the memes decide our fiscal future.
